headline: Colombia Considers Selling Idle Assets to Fund New Mega-Prisons
summary: Colombia's justice minister announced that the state may sell idle assets to finance the construction of mega-prisons as police holding cells operate at double capacity.
why: State asset divestments can alter public sector capital allocation and create localized investment or contracting opportunities.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Government asset sales impact public finances and infrastructure investment priorities.
